TABLE.NAME: block_le_dashboard_year
TABLE.COMMENT: Academic years used to scope the staff and convenor views

FIELD.NAME: timestart
FIELD.COMMENT: First second of the year (inclusive)

FIELD.NAME: timeend
FIELD.COMMENT: First second after the year (exclusive)

TABLE.NAME: block_le_dashboard_cm
TABLE.COMMENT: Assessment index: one row per tagged assessment (derived data, rebuildable)

FIELD.NAME: adapter
FIELD.COMMENT: Adapter that indexed the row: the module name, or generic

FIELD.NAME: assesstype
FIELD.COMMENT: summative or formative, from tags

FIELD.NAME: due
FIELD.COMMENT: Default deadline

FIELD.NAME: cutoff
FIELD.COMMENT: Default cut-off, after which nothing can be submitted

FIELD.NAME: hasbrief
FIELD.COMMENT: 1 when the activity has a description or a brief file

FIELD.NAME: stages
FIELD.COMMENT: Comma-separated marking stage keys, in order

FIELD.NAME: nosubmission
FIELD.COMMENT: 1 when students hand nothing in online (attendance, in-person, mark-only)

FIELD.NAME: norelease
FIELD.COMMENT: 1 when grades are never released to students (a quiz that never shows marks)

FIELD.NAME: setup
FIELD.COMMENT: Settings to check, comma-separated: nodue, nograde, nomarks, bothtags; null when none

TABLE.NAME: block_le_dashboard_stu
TABLE.COMMENT: Assessment index: one row per student per assessment (derived data, rebuildable)

FIELD.NAME: due
FIELD.COMMENT: Effective deadline for this student

FIELD.NAME: cutoff
FIELD.COMMENT: Effective cut-off for this student

FIELD.NAME: individual
FIELD.COMMENT: 1 when an override, personal deadline or extension applies

FIELD.NAME: mitigation
FIELD.COMMENT: extension or selfcert when one applies

FIELD.NAME: reopened
FIELD.COMMENT: 1 when a new attempt is open and not yet submitted

FIELD.NAME: allocatedto
FIELD.COMMENT: Markers allocated to the student, as ,id,id, (activities with allocation)

FIELD.NAME: canaccess
FIELD.COMMENT: Restrictions and groups, as of indexing

FIELD.NAME: active
FIELD.COMMENT: 0 when the enrolment is suspended or ended: their work is still marked, but they leave the submission counts

FIELD.NAME: enrolstart
FIELD.COMMENT: When the student joined the course, for late joiners

FIELD.NAME: submitted
FIELD.COMMENT: NULL when the adapter cannot tell

FIELD.NAME: timereleased
FIELD.COMMENT: When the grade is or will be visible to the student; NULL if not released

TABLE.NAME: block_le_dashboard_mark
TABLE.COMMENT: Assessment index: one row per marking unit per stage (derived data, rebuildable)

FIELD.NAME: unitid
FIELD.COMMENT: User or group id

FIELD.NAME: timeready
FIELD.COMMENT: When the unit became ready at this stage, when known

FIELD.NAME: unitdue
FIELD.COMMENT: The unit's effective deadline: the student's own, or a group's latest member deadline

FIELD.NAME: released
FIELD.COMMENT: Agreed or final grade published to the student (D4)

FIELD.NAME: flagged
FIELD.COMMENT: 1 when the submission is flagged for an academic conduct (plagiarism) check
